overrides.reason: E1 shows an offline per-frame evaluation of the FBX finds this hover (0.46-0.68 m at game scale) before import; no metadata count does.

Rendering every GLB in glTF coordinates shows the front faces +Z, as the glTF spec requires; the game's importer (UniGLTF, reverseAxis=Default -> Z) maps it to Unity -Z. A spec-compliant hand-made GLB would face the same way, so the root cause is the importer convention, not the generated asset.
